authority: T0 exact fixed-regulator passive Gaussian control and interacting-route split; not a TECT claim, tier change, interacting CL8 characteristic theorem, physical-state theorem, CP1 completion, or Pre-A closure
comparison_context: the rank-deficient D-K-D neighbour block in EXP-000743
statement: For every fixed even M>=4, each of the M inherited CL8 regulator legs carries exactly the existing eight canonical pairs p=(a/8)Pi. A species-diagonal two-leg passive rotation with gamma^2+eta^2=1 and gamma*eta nonzero has full-rank opposite-input blocks, exact oriented sideways inverses, and no added canonical degree of freedom. On every finite directed rectangle with arm lengths m+n=M, the west-plus-south two-arm data uniquely reconstruct every admissible monotone cut; local flux cancellation proves that every cut map is orthogonal and symplectic, independent of sweep order, and exactly causal. The same forward cut maps have exact metaplectic/Weyl and B(H) implementations. An inserted oscillator number is positive and invariant, its vacuum and finite-temperature Gibbs densities form an exact cut-covariant normal family, and the same densities are stationary for the periodic fixed-algebra companion. This closes only a passive linear-control subgate. The inherited positive CL8 onsite quartic kick does not preserve that number or its vacuum/Gibbs states, so it cannot be appended while reusing the control state and energy ledger. This no-go does not obstruct classical local sideways inversion of a kicked gate. The interacting common-parent characteristic gate tiling and common invariant-or-work/state proof remain open.
verdict: CLOSE AN EXACT SAME-DIMENSION PASSIVE TWO-ARM SYMPLECTIC, QUANTUM, ENERGY, AND STATE CONTROL; FORMALLY REJECT AUTOMATIC REUSE OF ITS NUMBER/GIBBS LEDGER AFTER THE CL8 QUARTIC KICK; KEEP THE INTERACTING CHARACTERISTIC PARENT OPEN

fixed_regulator.domain: M is even and M>=4; L>0, a=L/M and w=a/8 are declared; each cut has exactly M legs and each leg carries eight inherited canonical pairs
fixed_regulator.leg_dimension: 16 real canonical coordinates; the complete cut dimension is 16M
fixed_regulator.symplectic_form: Omega_leg=sum_e dp_e wedge dq_e; Omega_cut is the oriented sum over its M legs
fixed_regulator.boundary_to_CL8_identification: enumerating the M boundary legs by the M CL8 node labels is a canonical relabelling of the same 16M-dimensional phase space; no left/right ancilla, oscillator truncation, or hidden complement is added
fixed_regulator.inserted_data: the brickwork pairing, directed-rectangle orientation, characteristic/null interpretation, microstep, hbar, oscillator complex structure and frequency nu are inputs rather than consequences of the CL8 static functional

passive_local_gate.parameter_domain: gamma and eta are real, gamma^2+eta^2=1, and gamma*eta is nonzero
passive_local_gate.temporal_result: G is orthogonal and symplectic for Omega_W+Omega_S and has inverse G^T
passive_local_gate.full_rank_result: all four 16-by-16 input-output blocks have rank 16 throughout the declared domain; in particular the opposite-input block has rank 16 rather than the inherited split circuit's rank 8
passive_local_gate.rational_fixture_rule: for integers u>v>0, gamma=(u^2-v^2)/(u^2+v^2) and eta=2uv/(u^2+v^2); u=2,v=1 gives gamma=3/5 and eta=4/5 without fitting

sideways_inverses.orientation: both maps preserve the nondegenerate oriented form Gamma=Omega_first-Omega_second; the signs come from moving an outgoing edge to the input side of the flux identity
sideways_inverses.uniformity: the displayed inverses exist on the complete 16-coordinate leg space for every admitted gamma,eta, not merely at the rational fixture or a tangent point
sideways_inverses.state_boundary: after the reversed arm is identified with a standard positive-orientation oscillator, a mixed sideways inverse is a squeeze and does not preserve the passive number or Gibbs density; stationarity is claimed only for monotone cut maps composed from the original passive G gates
sideways_inverses.quantum_orientation: the signed classical map acts between an oriented tensor product H_first tensor conjugate(H_second) and its output analogue; momentum reversal is anti-symplectic on a same-positive-orientation factor, so no same-orientation metaplectic unitary or strict continuous-variable dual-unitarity is claimed for a literal reshuffling

two_arm_boundary.rectangle: choose positive integers m,n with m+n=M and vertices (i,j), 1<=i<=m, 1<=j<=n
two_arm_boundary.incoming_arms: west edges X_(0,j), j=1,...,n, and south edges Y_(i,0), i=1,...,m
two_arm_boundary.corner: the arms meet geometrically at the southwest corner but share no directed edge variable; there is no duplicated corner coordinate and no independent third datum
two_arm_boundary.constraints: none for this edge-variable control; the admissible space is the full 16M-dimensional input space, its symplectic radical is zero, and the quotient is the same space
two_arm_boundary.outputs: east edges X_(m,j) and north edges Y_(i,n), again M complete CL8 legs

global_cut_theorem.admissible_cut: a monotone frontier of an order ideal in the m-by-n vertex poset; equivalently nonincreasing row lengths r_1>=...>=r_n with 0<=r_j<=m
global_cut_theorem.cut_legs: the n horizontal edges X_(r_j,j) together with the m vertical edges Y_(i,c_i), where c_i=max{j:r_j>=i} and c_i=0 if the set is empty
global_cut_theorem.existence_uniqueness: the recurrence determines every internal edge by induction on i+j; reversing local gates reconstructs the two input arms from every admissible cut
global_cut_theorem.sweep_independence: row-first, column-first and every topological sweep give the same edge values because each vertex has a unique pair of predecessors and incomparable local replacements commute
global_cut_theorem.flux_and_energy: at each vertex Omega_W+Omega_S=Omega_E+Omega_N and ||W||^2+||S||^2=||E||^2+||N||^2; summing cancels every internal edge, so every input-to-cut matrix is orthogonal and symplectic
global_cut_theorem.causality: X_(i,j) and Y_(i,j) depend only on west-arm indices at or below j and south-arm indices at or left of i; all coefficients outside that finite southwest rectangle vanish exactly
global_cut_theorem.cut_count: the finite rectangle has binomial(m+n,m) admissible monotone cuts

periodic_Cauchy_companion.construction: on the same even periodic M-node phase space, apply G on disjoint even bonds and then on disjoint odd bonds, including the periodic wrap bond
periodic_Cauchy_companion.result: each half-layer is an orthogonal symplectic radius-one circuit; one full brickwork period is reversible, orthogonal, symplectic and has graph radius at most two
periodic_Cauchy_companion.boundary: this companion verifies same-phase-space finite-depth causality but is a new passive update, not the inherited nonlinear CL8 D-K-D circuit and not an exact time step of the autonomous CL8 Hamiltonian

quantum_cut_model.Hilbert_space: each leg is H_leg=L2(R^8); every M-leg cut is canonically H_cut=L2(R^(8M)) after the declared edge enumeration
quantum_cut_model.Weyl_algebra: the regular finite-dimensional Weyl CCR algebra for the complete 16M-dimensional cut phase space, kept distinct from B(H_cut)
quantum_cut_model.implementation: every input-to-cut matrix is passive linear symplectic and has a metaplectic, equivalently bosonic second-quantized, unitary U_cut; conjugation is a normal B(H) star-isomorphism and maps Weyl generators exactly
quantum_cut_model.directions: the kinematic map sends W_in(z) to W_cut(Cz); with the fixed-algebra Heisenberg convention alpha(A)=U^*AU and W(z)=exp(i*sigma(z,Z)/hbar), alpha(W(z))=W(C^(-1)z)
quantum_cut_model.inverse: C^T=C^(-1) and U_cut^* implement the inverse cut reconstruction
quantum_cut_model.nonlinear_boundary: this is a passive Gaussian theorem only; it does not quantize the nonlinear CL8 Goursat map by direct Weyl-generator relabelling

state_and_energy.classical_generator: I_nu=(1/2)sum_(j,e)[nu*q_(j,e)^2+p_(j,e)^2/nu] is a positive invariant action under every local gate, admissible cut map and periodic companion; the oscillator energy is H_nu=nu*I_nu
state_and_energy.quantum_generator: N=sum a^*a and K_nu=hbar*nu*N are nonnegative, commute with every cut and brickwork unitary, and have compact resolvent at fixed M
state_and_energy.normal_state: for beta_T>0, rho_beta=(1-exp(-beta_T*hbar*nu))^(8M)*exp(-beta_T*hbar*nu*N) is faithful, positive, trace one and trace class; it is a cut-covariant family under every admissible monotone input-to-cut unitary and is genuinely stationary on the one fixed algebra under the periodic brickwork companion; the same statements hold for the vacuum projector
state_and_energy.transport: arbitrary input densities transport by rho_cut=U_cut*rho_in*U_cut^*, while U_cut*rho_beta*U_cut^*=rho_beta on the canonically enumerated target cut because U_cut commutes with N; this is cut covariance unless source and target algebras have been identified, whereas periodic brickwork gives fixed-algebra stationarity
state_and_energy.reference_convention: K_nu assigns the vacuum the declared normal-ordered value zero; the un-normal-ordered oscillator Hamiltonian differs by 4M*hbar*nu. Neither convention identifies physical empty space or a no-condensate state
state_and_energy.selection_boundary: nu, hbar, beta_T, the complex structure and the ground/KMS rule are inputs, and the continuum of beta_T states again prevents stationarity alone from selecting a physical state

CL8_quartic_reuse_no_go.attempt: append the inherited positive onsite CL8 quartic position kick to the passive two-arm gate while automatically retaining K_nu and its vacuum/Gibbs states
CL8_quartic_reuse_no_go.classical_witness: for one coordinate p maps to p-delta*w*g*q^3, so Delta I_nu=-(delta*w*g/nu)*p*q^3+(delta^2*w^2*g^2/(2nu))*q^6; at p=0 and nonzero q,delta this is strictly positive
CL8_quartic_reuse_no_go.quantum_witness: with Q=sqrt(hbar/(2nu))*(a+a^*), the exact matrix element <4|[N,Q^4]|0>=4*sqrt(24)*(hbar/(2nu))^2 is nonzero; multiplication of the strictly positive oscillator vacuum by exp(-i*delta*w*g*x^4/(4hbar)) is not a scalar multiple for any nonzero delta*w*g
CL8_quartic_reuse_no_go.conclusion: the passive number, vacuum and Gibbs stationarity cannot be reused after the CL8 quartic kick without a new invariant generator and state proof
CL8_quartic_reuse_no_go.classical_sideways_boundary: this is not a classical inversion no-go: for F=G after a q-only kick with gradients V_W,V_S, given pre-kick W=(q_W,p_W) and output N one first solves q_S=(q_N+eta*q_W)/gamma, evaluates the gradients, and then solves p_S=[p_N+eta*(p_W-delta*V_W)]/gamma+delta*V_S; the unresolved work is the actual CL8 coupling assignment, global gate tiling, all-cut theorem and common invariant-or-work/state ledger
CL8_quartic_reuse_no_go.survivors: the exact local quartic work increment, a different interacting positive invariant, an explicit global work ledger, a nonlinear number-conserving model with a proved CL8 reduction, or an enlarged B(H) construction with a separately transported state

prior_art_boundary: Passive linear-optical beam splitters, Gaussian/metaplectic circuits, reversible lattice gases, symplectic vertex models, tensor-network cut evolution and bosonic Gibbs states are established mathematics and physics. No new general theorem or world-first claim is made. The repository-specific contribution is the exact CL8 a/8 convention bridge, same-dimension two-arm/corner ledger, all-cut audit against the registered rank obstruction, and the explicit firewall between the passive stationary control and the inherited Q3 quartic interaction.
no_overclaim: This package proves only an exact passive Gaussian two-arm characteristic control on each fixed finite CL8 phase space and a narrow obstruction to reusing its number/Gibbs ledger after the CL8 quartic kick. It does not implement or intertwine the inherited nonlinear Q3 dynamics, prove a full interacting boundary algebra, select a physical state, identify physical empty space or a below-empty-space sign, construct regulator-compatible states, take a continuum or Hadamard limit, derive hbar, time, nullness, Lorentzian signature or light speed, prove a phase transition or cooling, reconstruct 3+1 dynamics, gravity, a horizon or a cycle, advance C6, close C0 or N1-N5, complete CP1, or complete Pre-A.
